recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Further FHIR-17062 source edits would duplicate the current normative comment or risk undoing the later FHIR-43101 type/id clarification; unrelated spelling or casing cleanup should stay with separate trackers.
issue_request: FHIR-17062 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-I change request for FHIR-core-Feed. It asked to improve the Bundle.entry.fullUrl comment because merely saying a RESTful-looking fullUrl must end with Resource.id was insufficient; the wording needed to distinguish URNs and non-RESTful absolute URLs from RESTful server URLs and require the RESTful URL id portion to match Resource.id.
initial_application: The Jira snapshot records Grahame Grieve's svn 13498 application comment. The original SVN revision is not directly available in the current Git history, but the first Git-traceable migration of the Bundle StructureDefinition source already contained the FHIR-17062 wording that fullUrl may be a URN or an absolute URL that does not end with Resource.id, while still using the older id-only RESTful URL formulation.
additional_context: Bundle is active current-build source in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-15139 is the closely related earlier fullUrl clarification that distinguished endpoint fullUrls from canonical URLs and confirmed urn:uuid fullUrls do not need to match Resource.id. FHIR-43101 later refined the same Bundle.entry.fullUrl comment to require RESTful-looking fullUrls to match both resource type and id, and that later issue is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml comment already says fullUrl may be a URN or other absolute URL that does not end with Resource.id and, if it looks like a RESTful server URL, the URL portion corresponding to resource type and id SHALL match the resource type and id of the resource.

related_jiras.note: Earlier fullUrl clarification established endpoint URL versus canonical URL semantics and urn:uuid behavior, supporting the current non-RESTful fullUrl exception.
Later Applied/Persuasive issue refined the same Bundle.entry.fullUrl sentence to require RESTful-looking fullUrls to match both resource type and id; it is already represented on the combined branch.
